facts.business: Venky's (India) Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of food and beverages, primarily poultry products including grown-up commercial broilers, day-old commercial chicks, refined oil, de-oiled cake for poultry feed, animal health products, poultry feed, and processed chicken.

capacity_or_capex.item: Solar systems installation for electricity generation

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company will distribute dividend up to 10% of its after-tax profits in each financial year.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpts

key_risks: Higher volatility in prices of feed ingredients
facts.related_party_note: The Company and its related parties operate in the same line of business. The Company has significant transactions with the related parties which have an effect on both - statement of profit and loss and balance sheet. Such related party transactions are required to be undertaken in accordance with the provisions of section 177 and section 188 of the Act and IND AS 24.
